name: Hera
summary: AI-native creative canvas for generating images, designs and motion ads with editable layers.
description: Hera is a YC-backed creative canvas where users brief multiple AI agents to generate images, layered designs and short motion/ads on one board, then edit every generation as layers. Differentiator is staying on one canvas from brief to animation with brand kits and multi-agent direction. Homepage offers get-started-for-free; paid Pro plans exist for higher usage (exact public price table partly app-gated; Freemium verified from free start).
features: Brief multiple AI agents on one canvas
